overlay.content.h1: What Is an Image Overlay? Digital Compositing for Web & Creative Design
overlay.content.p1a: An image overlay is a digital composition technique where one graphic or photo layer is positioned on top of another base image. Whether you are adding a transparent PNG brand watermark to your photography, stamping a YouTube play badge onto video thumbnails, crafting surreal double exposures, or creating comparative before-and-after graphics, image overlaying is a cornerstone of modern graphic design and visual storytelling.
overlay.content.p1b: ImgFeel's Image Overlay Tool provides a fast, privacy-first, in-browser studio for placing one image over another with millimetric precision. You have complete creative control over multi-layer positioning, live touch/mouse drag coordinates, proportional scaling, rotation angles, alpha transparency, and HTML5 canvas blend modes—all processed directly on your device without uploading confidential files to any external server.
overlay.content.feat1Desc: Freely reposition overlay layers by dragging directly on the live canvas or clicking one of the 9 alignment presets.
overlay.content.feat2Desc: Adjust layer transparency from 0% to 100% and apply blend modes like Multiply, Screen, Overlay, and Soft Light.
overlay.content.feat3Desc: Scale logos and graphics seamlessly from a 25% corner watermark to full-bleed coverage with flip and rotation.
overlay.content.feat4Desc: All rendering takes place inside your browser memory using HTML5 Canvas. Zero data upload, zero tracking, and zero wait.
overlay.content.h2: Essential Use Cases for Overlaying Images
overlay.content.p2a: From commercial branding to social media engagement, image overlays are used across diverse creative workflows:
overlay.content.use1Desc: Protect your photography, architectural renderings, and digital artwork by placing semi-transparent logo watermarks in corners or across the center.
overlay.content.use2Desc: Add YouTube play buttons, verified badges, rating stars, discount stickers, and trending stamps onto promotional banners.
overlay.content.use3Desc: Overlay custom illustrations, typography, and logos onto t-shirts, mugs, computer monitors, and packaging templates.
overlay.content.use4Desc: Blend portraits with landscape textures, urban skylines, or starry night skies using Screen and Soft Light blend modes.
overlay.content.use5Desc: Overlay transparent comparison grids, crosshair markers, or corner badges to demonstrate design iterations and photo restorations.
overlay.content.h3: Understanding Canvas Blend Modes & Alpha Transparency
overlay.content.p3a: When overlaying images, how the top layer interacts with the bottom layer defines the visual mood. Using alpha-transparent PNG or WebP files ensures crisp cutouts without blocky white boxes around your graphics.
overlay.content.p3b: Our tool integrates standard canvas blend modes that calculate pixel color interactions mathematically:
overlay.content.p4a: Proper alignment creates visual harmony. For non-intrusive watermarking, the bottom-right and bottom-left corners are industry standards, preserving the main focal subject while securing intellectual property. Use our edge margin slider to maintain breathable padding from image borders.
overlay.content.p4b: For promotional discount badges or sale stickers, the top-right corner commands immediate optical attention according to natural Z-pattern eye tracking. For cinematic double exposures and logo hero reveals, the dead-center alignment provides perfect symmetry.
overlay.content.p5a: Exporting composite images requires maintaining pixel clarity. When saving photos with transparent overlays or crisp typographic logos, PNG format preserves lossless color channels without fuzzy compression artifacts around sharp edges.
overlay.content.p5b: If you are preparing graphics for mobile web pages or e-commerce catalogs where fast loading speed is essential, WebP format provides superior compression efficiency with full alpha transparency support.
overlay.content.h6: Step-by-Step Guide: How to Overlay One Image on Another
overlay.content.step1Desc: Select or drag your background photo into the Base Layer card, and your logo, watermark, or second photo into the Overlay Layer card.
overlay.content.step2Desc: Click a preset on the 9-point grid or drag the overlay directly on the preview canvas. Adjust the scale slider to achieve your desired size.
overlay.content.step3Desc: Lower opacity for subtle watermarks or select a blend mode like Screen or Multiply for creative artistic textures.
overlay.content.step4Desc: Choose your preferred format (PNG, WebP, JPG) and click Download Composite or Copy Image for instant pasting into your design workflow.
overlay.faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
overlay.faq.q1: How do I put one image over another online?
overlay.faq.a1: Upload your background photo as the Base Image and your second photo/logo as the Overlay Image. Use the alignment grid or drag on the preview canvas to position it, adjust scale and opacity, and click Download.
overlay.faq.q2: Can I overlay a transparent PNG logo without a white background?
overlay.faq.a2: Yes! The tool fully supports alpha-transparent PNG and WebP graphics. Your logo will overlay smoothly onto the base photo with clean, transparent edges.
overlay.faq.q3: Can I drag the overlay freely on the image?
overlay.faq.a3: Yes. You can touch or click and drag the overlay layer directly inside the live canvas viewport to place it anywhere you want with real-time coordinate tracking.
overlay.faq.q4: How do blend modes like Multiply and Screen work?
overlay.faq.a4: Multiply blends dark areas and makes white backgrounds disappear (great for black sketches and stamps), while Screen blends bright areas and makes black backgrounds transparent (great for light flares and glowing graphics).
overlay.faq.q5: Can I swap the base and overlay layers?
overlay.faq.a5: Yes. Click the 'Swap Layers' button to instantly switch which image acts as the background canvas and which acts as the foreground overlay.
overlay.faq.q6: Can I copy the final composited image directly to my clipboard?
overlay.faq.a6: Yes! Click 'Copy Image' to copy the composite PNG directly to your system clipboard so you can paste it into Slack, Figma, Photoshop, or social media apps.
overlay.faq.q7: Is my uploaded imagery safe and private?
overlay.faq.a7: 100% private. All composite rendering and calculations happen locally inside your browser using HTML5 Canvas. Your images are never uploaded to any server or stored remotely.
